title_hi: एपिसोडिक मेमोरी: अध्ययन वास्तव में क्या मापते हैं?
topic: episodic memory, free recall, recognition, source/context memory, confidence, and task-specific measurement
unique_angle: Episodic-memory studies measure distinct task outputs—recall, recognition, source/context, order, confidence, and model-based estimates—that should not be treated as interchangeable or as a complete readout of autobiographical memory.
evidence_class: peer-reviewed episodic-memory measurement study, episodic-like behavioral toolbox review, recognition/source confidence study, and item-source memory review
safety_boundary: Public education only. Task performance, subjective confidence, and neural/model-derived proxies are not diagnosis, treatment, personal prediction, or individualized cognitive assessment.
